'''Krol-Pek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] and encryption expert who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], the [[Genarius]]-based [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Salld Nrump]] discovered evidence of the existence of three [[data transmitter]]s that were being used by the [[Metatheran Cartel]] to covertly gather information in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], and he contacted Krol-Pek to discuss his findings. Shortly afterward, Nrump went on the run from the [[Red Fury Brotherhood/Legends|Red Fury Brotherhood]], a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] organization that sought to use the transmitter for it's own purposes, and Krol-Pek arranged passage for Nrump to Cularin, aboard the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] ''[[The Panada's Kiss]]''. However, Nrump was subsequently [[Death/Legends|murdered]] by [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] hired by the Brotherhood, and some [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] traveled to Cularin in Nrump's place and rendezvoused with Krol-Pek.
